utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, I’m still a bit behind on the repair drive. I’ll check the latest details and get back to you once I know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Mara

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thank you — I’ll keep that set and the Sunday community center plan in mind, and I’ll check in if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Bo — pickup and drop-off will make a big difference. I’ll keep telling folks it’s Sunday at the community center so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — Sunday at the community center. I’ll spread the word and work it around my shift.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep passing along the update so everyone hears Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — I’ll share the final parts list as soon as it’s locked in. Thanks for being flexible!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still best right after pickup, from 3:15 to 4:00. Just tell me the key repair items and what you need from me for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll bring the key repair items and the rest of what we promised for Sunday at the community center. I’ll need you there from 3:15 to 4:00 after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I can be there from 3:15 to 4:00 after pickup. Just send me the short list of what you want me to handle.

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great—Sunday at the community center is the version I’ll follow. Just send the written bring-list and schedule early so we all stay on the same plan.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—I’ll keep to Sunday at the community center and send the bring-list and schedule early.

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good. That’s the confirmed plan, then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll stick to that and see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I can handle the sorting and tool check for the repair drive on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, great — Sunday at the community center sounds right. I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’m happy to help if there’s anything you still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell — if you can help sort and check the tools, that’d be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Repair drive’s moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll send the main issue next.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll spread the word fast and keep it to one clear update. Send me the main issue and I’ll make sure everyone sees it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Main issue: we need hands on Sunday at the community center. I’ll send any exact timing if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — Sunday at the community center works. Just send me the fixes we’re covering and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll send over the list of fixes, and then we’ll be set for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m still waiting on something in writing before I treat it as confirmed. If Opal has the posted schedule or a doc for the repair drive, send it over and I’ll review it.

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — I’ll wait for the schedule before I treat it as confirmed. Once you send it, I’ll review the details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pick one task and give me a time. Donations, pickup, or sorting — which one can you do, and when?

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sorting on Sunday afternoon at the community center is the commitment. I’ll count on you for that — and keep the rest to a minimum unless I ask.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Just a quick reminder: the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now, and we’re still set for the drill, screws, and tape measure.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. I’ll check the drive and send back the main issue.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — please send the main issue when you’ve checked it, and we’ll keep the plan tight for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’m happy to help with the repair drive if there’s anything I can do.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Nell — could you help by sending the updated plan and keeping the Sunday community center version as the one we all use? If you can also note who’s handling donations, that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure — I’ll pass along the Sunday community center plan and keep that as the one we use. I’ll also ask around about who’s handling donations.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks — just the confirmed details on what’s left for the repair drive, if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: The confirmed update is it’s moved to Sunday at the community center. I’m still just on pickup and drop-off, and I haven’t locked in any supplies yet.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks. So the only confirmed update is Sunday at the community center, and pickup, drop-off, and supplies are still open?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I still need a confirmed source before I treat the repair drive as set. If you have a document or link, send it over and I’ll review it right away.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep — I’ve got the update that it moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll send the written details and parts list over so you can check them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — send the written update and parts list, and I’ll verify the details before we treat it as confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still best right after pickup from 3:15 to 4:00—what do you need from me for the repair drive at the community center on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got you down for Sunday at the community center, right after pickup from 3:15 to 4:00. If you can handle any supplies, tell me which ones and I’ll add them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can take the basic supplies list—tape, screws, and a couple of boxes. Keep it tight and send me anything else you need before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Just checking in: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’ll post the update in the group chat so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect — Sunday at the community center is much easier to pass along. I’m glad it’s all set now, and I’ll keep sharing the update.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Quick update: the repair drive moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep passing along the details so nobody shows up at the wrong place or time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thank you — Sunday at the community center, got it. I’ll bring the drill, the box of screws, and the tape measure if that still fits the latest list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That fits perfectly — bring them along, and I’ll keep an ear out for any other tools folks need. Sunday at the community center is the spot now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll get the updated repair drive word out fast: Sunday at the community center, with one clear place for details and updates. If Rey wants to help, tell me what they can bring and I’ll add it to the invite.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I can handle sorting and the tool check. Just point me to the updated sheet and I’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll send you the updated sheet right now and note sorting plus tool check under your name. Let’s keep everything in one place and make this easy to track.
